specs.name: 감긴 태엽
specs.direction: MAINSPRING COIL. Use readable, substantial custom silver serif capitals with short carved wedge terminals. Behind and slightly ABOVE the T/E centre is ONE unmistakable flat steel mainspring wound in a tight spiral of 3 to 4 visible flat ribbon turns. It is not a halo or an orbit: show the squared metal ribbon edge and a small central arbor. The coil is partly occluded by the word; its loose end flows into a restrained lower stroke of the lettering, connecting the composition. A small violet enamel point on the arbor, violet inner shadows, broad pearly letter fronts. Graceful asymmetry, inviting magic and tangible precision. No clock dial, no clock hands, no large gears in this variant; the spiral spring is its signature.
specs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original, finished illustrated fantasy RPG title logo for ASTELLA. Exact text: "ASTELLA", seven uppercase letters A S T E L L A, clearly readable in this exact order on one horizontal line. No extra words, labels or numerals.
The new visual theme is CLOCKWORK: real flat coiled mainsprings, deliberately cut gear teeth, stopped clock hands and engraved silver watch parts. The story contains a clock tower, a twelfth bell and stopped time. Use that as a visual direction, not an explanation or a spoiler. The clockwork must be physically integrated with the letters rather than a random circle pasted behind ordinary text.
Art quality: high-quality painterly 3D fantasy title art, carefully carved metal letter bodies, narrow crisp bevels, believable subtle depth, restrained pearly highlights. Palette: pale silver, cool ivory, dark indigo recesses and small amethyst-violet accents in the mechanism. This belongs over a violet crystal woodland title screen. Keep the title dominant and legible when displayed 600px wide. Mechanical ornament occupies roughly a quarter of the whole silhouette, with clean negative spaces.
Generate a wide self-contained horizontal logo, about 3:1 to 3.5:1, on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, with a safe transparent margin and every letter/part fully visible. No opaque backdrop, checkerboard, scenery, UI or shadow floor. EXACTLY ONE logo, not a contact sheet.

specs.name: 맞물린 시간
specs.direction: MESHED ESCAPEMENT. Build a distinctive compact upright alphabet of tall angular silver capitals with cropped rather than sweeping terminals. Integrate TWO interlocking silver gears into the lower middle of the word: a smaller escape wheel with a few clearly shaped asymmetric teeth and a larger, partly hidden gear. Their actual teeth mesh cleanly. A tiny forked pallet-like lever meets the escape wheel, visually suggesting a mechanical escapement without engineering labels. Some open letter counters reveal cut-out metal bridges and deep indigo space. Small amethyst inlay on one gear bridge. The metal mechanism is visible through and between letters, not a separate full clock disc. Symmetric overall weight, jewel-like small precision and clear ASTELLA. No big spiral spring, no visible clock face or hands.

specs.name: 멈춘 초침
specs.direction: THE STOPPED HAND AS LETTERING. Create elegant forward-flowing silver capital lettering, readable original tapered strokes, with the horizontal of the T becoming a long finely sculpted CLOCK HAND. A small round pivot at T's upper centre carries one shorter still hand at a contrasting angle. The long hand extends gracefully across part of the word without obscuring other letters. Below it, only TWO short engraved partial arcs with fine tick marks hint at a dial; most of the circular face is absent. A tiny amethyst pin at the pivot. This is lyrical and airy, not a huge watch. Keep the mechanism integrated in the title's silhouette. No cogwheel cluster, no mainspring coil, no pendant jewel or heavy rectangular border.

specs.name: 깨진 태엽
specs.direction: A BROKEN UNWINDING SPRING. Confident broad metal serif capitals, with slightly aged brushed silver faces and carefully cut violet-lined seams. A fractured flat ribbon mainspring sits partly behind the left A/S, two tight coil turns still wound, one broken end unfurling in a long shallow silver curve toward the final A. Two short separated silver ribbon pieces show that the spring has snapped. Fine diagonal cracks only on small parts of the metal, never breaking word legibility. Subtle amethyst light only in a few exposed recesses. Strong intentional asymmetry, tension and a sense of stopped machinery. No smoke or floating debris cloud, no complete clock face, no clock hands, no big gemstone. Different silhouette from a neat complete spring.

specs.name: 회중시계
specs.direction: AN ANTIQUE SILVER POCKETWATCH TITLE. Shape a beautiful broad silver title around a minimal OPEN pocketwatch case: the first A is partly nested into the left side of the open case ring, and the remaining STELLA letters extend clearly to the right, creating an asymmetric horizontal identity. Above the left A is a SMALL recognisable winding crown and bow, with crisp silver ridges. Only a partial face rim and a few engraved ticks are visible; the letters remain the main subject. Small visible gearwork at the lower left connects into a thin silver metal stroke, with a violet enamel interior and subdued pearly highlights. Refined antique mechanical craft, not brass steampunk, no giant circular badge in the middle. No long chain, no extra numerals or text, no detached diamond below the middle.
